title: Evaluation preserved under fanout reduction
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, whose gates are in topological order and whose designated output is a circuit vertex. Suppose each gate reads distinct vertices, each negation gate reads exactly one vertex, and every gate reads at most two vertices. Then, for every assignment $x$ of Boolean values to the input vertices, the circuit obtained from $C$ by the fanout-two construction has the same output value as $C$.
